description: This Dart source file defines a utility class `SampleAssetSaver` that enables copying a specified asset PDF file into the application's documents directory, overwriting any existing file, and returning its absolute path or null on failure.

classes.name: SampleAssetSaver
classes.description: A utility class for copying a specific asset PDF file into the app's documents directory, primarily used for testing or file management within the app.

methods.name: saveSampleIdPdf
methods.description: Loads the asset 'assets/sample/sample_id.pdf' and writes it to the app's documents directory as 'sample_id.pdf', overwriting existing file if present. Returns the absolute file path on success or null if there is an error.
